meta.title: Yudi (Jade Emperor) Spirit Sign - S-Jiffy
meta.description: The Yudi spirit sign has 28 lots, for reverently asking the ruler of heaven about fortune, misfortune, blessings and life prospects.
desc: The Yudi spirit sign has 28 lots, for reverently asking the ruler of heaven about fortune, misfortune, blessings and life prospects.
